map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.请求同一 CDN 静态文件，读取 cf-ray / x-served-by /: Request the same CDN static file, read cf-ray / x-served-by / x-cache headers, falling back to RTT fingerprint.
map.多次请求指定 CDN 文件，尝试读取 cf-ray、x-served-by、x-: Repeatedly requests the specified CDN file and tries to read cf-ray, x-served-by, x-cache edge headers; if CORS hides them, it falls back to round-trip time (RTT) as a node fingerprint.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「探测」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Probe" above to start.
map.从响应头读到的节点标识: Node identifier read from response headers
map.为什么读不到节点头？: Why can't I read edge headers?
map.跨域请求的自定义响应头默认被浏览器隐藏（CORS），除非 CDN 显式允许，此时: Custom response headers on cross-origin requests are hidden unless the CDN allows them via CORS.
map.默认用 jsDelivr 的静态文件，可在输入框改成其它 CDN 地址。: jsDelivr static file by default; edit the input for other CDNs.
map.只能粗略反映网络远近，不能精确定位物理位置。: Only a rough network-distance hint, not a precise physical location.
